from litestar import Litestar, asgi
from litestar.response.base import ASGIResponse
from litestar.types import Receive, Scope, Send
from litestar.testing import TestClient

@asgi("/admin", is_mount=True, copy_scope=True)
async def admin_mount(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
    response = ASGIResponse(body=b"mounted")
    await response(scope, receive, send)

def test_bug():
    app = Litestar(route_handlers=[admin_mount])
    with TestClient(app=app) as client:
        response = client.get("/administrator")
        assert response.status_code == 404
